avalancheActivity.highlights: Fresh and older wind slabs are to be assessed with care and prudence.
avalancheActivity.comment:
The sometimes strong wind has transported the new snow significantly. Adjacent to ridgelines and in gullies and bowls the wind slabs have increased in size additionally.
New snow and wind slabs can in some cases be released by a single winter sport participant. Above approximately 2300 m the avalanches can be triggered in the new snow and wind slab layers and reach large size. This applies in particular at transitions from a shallow to a deep snowpack.
In particular in steep rocky terrain small and medium-sized moist avalanches are possible as a consequence of solar radiation.
The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field, so that the avalanche danger should be investigated especially thoroughly in the relevant locality.

snowpackStructure.comment: 30 to 50 cm of snow has fallen since Tuesday above approximately 1500 m. The sometimes moderate wind has transported the new snow. Faceted weak layers exist in the snowpack in particular in places that are protected from the wind. This applies especially at high altitudes and in high Alpine regions.

avalancheActivity.highlights: Wind slabs at intermediate and high altitudes.
avalancheActivity.comment:
The sometimes strong wind has transported the new snow. In particular adjacent to ridgelines and in gullies and bowls small and, in isolated cases, medium-sized slab avalanches are possible. In addition the wind slabs are capable of being triggered in some locations. This applies in particular on very steep slopes.
In particular in steep rocky terrain small and medium-sized moist avalanches are possible as a consequence of solar radiation.
The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field.

avalancheActivity.highlights: Individual avalanche prone locations are to be found at high altitude.
avalancheActivity.comment:
The avalanche prone locations are very rare. They are to be found on extremely steep shady slopes at elevated altitudes and on wind-loaded slopes. As a consequence of solar radiation individual small natural moist avalanches are possible. Restraint should be exercised because avalanches can sweep people along and give rise to falls.
The Avalanche Warning Service currently has only a small amount of information that has been collected in the field.
